_note: Opt-in overlay. Wheel drive limits missing from the base plant: the hub motor's rated power (pods.hub_motor_power_w, present in the parameter file but unused) caps torque at P/omega, and a slip limiter (traction control) fades the drive torque between one and two times the slip limit. Without it an unloaded wheel under full drive overspins (452 rad/s seen at 82 m/s) and its touchdown produces an impulsive contact force.

limits_enabled.s: wheel drive limits overlay switch (1 = on)

traction_slip_max.s: slip ratio (omega r - v) / v at which traction control starts cutting drive torque; zero torque at 2x (road EV traction-control range ~0.1-0.2)

slip_reference_speed_min_m_s.s: floor on the reference speed in the slip ratio so launch from rest is not cut
